description: A security engineering manager must finalize containment, customer communication, and evidence-handling decisions after a potentially exposed CI credential appears in production build logs, with input from the CI platform, customer success, and compliance.

shared_context.S1: A production build log published yesterday contained a credential-like string that was visible to authenticated engineering users for approximately 37 minutes.
shared_context.S2: Initial triage found no confirmed misuse of the credential and no confirmed customer data access.
shared_context.S3: Maya owns the incident response decision and must finalize the containment and follow-up plan this afternoon.
shared_context.S4: The team's incident-review routine requires Maya to check with CI platform, customer success, and compliance before closing the response plan.

PF1.text: While tracing the build-log publication path this morning, Theo confirmed that the exposed credential belongs to the shared CI token pool and remains valid in six production repositories; he has not posted the repository list because he was still checking whether the logs were fully purged.

PF2.text: Lena confirmed with the affected enterprise account team 30 minutes ago that the customer's agreement requires notice within exactly 24 hours whenever an authentication credential may have been exposed, even without confirmed misuse; she has not updated the incident record because the account team is still confirming the customer contact.

PF3.text: During a separate audit-evidence review this morning, Omar confirmed that this incident's investigation artifacts must be stored in immutable evidence storage for exactly 365 days and receive a compliance sign-off; he has not opened the evidence task yet because the audit request arrived in a separate queue.

acceptance_conditions: The shared CI token pool must be revoked or rotated across all six production repositories.
The plan must commit to checking all six affected production repositories.
The enterprise customer must be notified within exactly 24 hours.
Incident artifacts must be retained in immutable evidence storage for exactly 365 days.
The plan must include commitments for credential containment, customer notification, and compliance evidence.

content_checks.C1: ('shared CI token' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) and ('six' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) and ('production repositories' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) and (('rotate' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) or ('revoke' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']))
content_checks.C2: decisions['all_six_repositories_check_committed'] == True or any(('all six' in c['detail'] or '6 production repositories' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: ('six' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) and ('production repositories' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) and (('all' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) or ('every' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']) or ('the' in decisions['credential_revocation_scope']))
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'customer_notice' or c['type'] == 'customer_notification' or ('24-hour' in c['detail'] and 'customer notice' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'evidence_collection' or c['type'] == 'evidence_retention' or c['type'] == 'evidence_preservation' or ('immutable' in c['detail'] and '365' in c['detail'] and 'compliance sign-off' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed shared-token scope changes containment from handling one credential to revoking or rotating the shared CI token across exactly six production repositories and committing to check those repositories.
The contract's authentication-exposure clause changes customer handling to an exact 24-hour notice deadline and requires a customer-notification commitment.
The audit requirement changes evidence handling to exactly 365 days in immutable storage, requires compliance sign-off, and requires an evidence commitment.
